''See also: [[Akura Charity Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Charity]] is a high-ranking member of the [[Akura clan]], holding the title of [[Sage of the Silver Heart]]. As a representative of her family, she possesses significant [[Authority|authority]], speaking on behalf of both the [[Akura clan]] and humanity. She is described as having a calm, composed, and often expressionless demeanor, frequently maintaining a cool or impassive [[The mask|mask]] regardless of the situation. Despite her youthful appearance and smooth voice, she carries herself with the confidence of an empress and has held the rank of [[Sage]] since before the birth of several current figures. [[Charity]]'s role involves high-level diplomacy, leadership, and the management of clan interests. She has engaged in political confrontations with emperors and kings, such as the [[Seishen King]], and has overseen major events like the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]]. Her influence extends to controlling territories, including ownership of [[Night Wheel Valley]] and its [[vault]]. While she is known for her legendary passion for humanity, she is also a pragmatic leader who accepts bloodshed as a necessary cost of competition and maintains the clan's [[Authority|authority]] through strategic interventions. She is the granddaughter of [[Akura Malice]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Charity]] has purple eyes and wears [[sacred artist's robe|sacred artist robes]] in black, white, and violet. Her silken black garments feature glowing violet lines that resemble [[Script|script]], though she has also been seen dressed like a peasant worker.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Described as unknowable, she acts as a spokesperson for both humanity and the [[Akura clan|Akura family]]. She is someone who would not hold deaths against anyone.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Charity]] is a member of [[Mercy]]'s family and has an unnamed nephew who suffered at the hands of a brute. She is connected to [[Lindon]], whom she assured would be [[safe]] in a dungeon, and her father is currently ascending. Additionally, she stole valuable [[Underlord|Underlords]] from [[Yerin]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a [[Sage]], she possesses [[Archlord]]'s power and can manipulate a chisel with her finger using a condensed [[sword aura]]. She utilizes the [[Book of the Silver Heart]], which contains seven techniques of [[Shadow|shadow]] and [[dreams]].}}
